alate: Head capsule brown, antennae, thorax, abdomen and legs pale brown. Head capsule subcircular and slightly elongate. Fontanelle small, with longitudinal striae in front of it. The anterior part of the frons bears shallow impressed lines. In lateral view the vertex is rather flat, the postclypeus slightly raised and situated lower than the ocelli. Antennae 17-segmented. Compound eyes elongate-oval, prominence about 15%; the distance between the compound eye and the lower margin of the head about one-fifth of the long diameter of the eye, the distance between the ocellus and the compound eye about one-half of the long diameter of the ocellus. Pronotum about 1.75 times as wide as long, the anterior margin shallowly concave in a broad V, the lateral margins broadly rounded, the posterior margin nearly straight and slightly concave at the centre. Forewing longer than hindwing, the forewing 7.4–7.9 mm long and 2.10–2.15 mm wide, the hindwing 7.1–7.4 mm long and 1.9–2.0 mm wide; the forewing scale larger than the hindwing scale, the base of the hindwing scale slightly overlapped by the forewing scale; cubitus comb-like, with about 10 or more branches.
biology: Host plants recorded: Chinese sweetgum, Ficus hispida, Quercus acutissima and Vernicia montana.
soldier: Head reddish brown, mandibles purplish brown, pronotum orange-brown, head capsule moderately haired.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Srylotermes in the original work, a spelling error for Stylotermes; the genus name currently in use is consistent with this.
